Name: Acid Arrow
Components: V, S, M (powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder’s stomach)
Description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target: on a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of their next turn, on a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of their next turn.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The initial and secondary damage increase by 1d4 each.
● You may choose an additional target within range.
● When the arrow misses and splashes for half damage, it also forces all creatures within 5 feet of its initial target to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the same half damage on a failure.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
